versions.changelog:
Initial release of Bolt.new AI fullstack development assistant.

- Provides browser-based Node.js development powered by WebContainer with zero setup.
- Supports AI-generated fullstack projects from natural language prompts, including multi-step revision.
- One-click deploys to Netlify for instant public sharing.
- Compatible with major modern frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Next.js, etc.) and tooling (TypeScript, Vite, Express, SQLite, etc.).
- Offers recommendations and prompt templates for optimal usage.
- Documents current limitations and best practices for using Bolt.new.
